type_attack_normal.fullDescription: Boosts the offensive stats of Normal-type Pokémon in your party. Attack +10%, Special Attack +10%, Speed +10%. Stackable, max 5 stacks.

type_defense_normal.fullDescription: Boosts the defensive stats of Normal-type Pokémon in your party. HP +10%, Defense +10%, Special Defense +10%. Stackable, max 5 stacks.

triple_passive_awakening.name: Triple Passive Awakening
triple_passive_awakening.shortDescription: Grant one Pokémon triple passive mode
triple_passive_awakening.fullDescription:
Select one Pokémon from your party to unlock its passive ability slots.
The Pokémon will keep its original passive ability and gain two additional random non-duplicate passive abilities.
All three passive abilities will be active simultaneously.

chaoji_beibao.name: Super Backpack
chaoji_beibao.shortDescription: Use backpack to store and use items in battle
chaoji_beibao.fullDescription:
After acquiring, a backpack button appears in battle.
The backpack automatically generates a random item every 10 turns, storing up to 5 items.
During Pokémon preparation and battle selection phases,
you can open the backpack to give items to Pokémon, retrieve items, or use items.
Requires 3 Pokémon Item tag talents.

miaomiao_cunqianguan.name: Meowth's Piggy Bank
miaomiao_cunqianguan.shortDescription: Money +1% at the end of each wave
miaomiao_cunqianguan.fullDescription:
At the end of each wave, current money increases by 1%.
Can be obtained up to 5 times.

miaomiao_jubaogong.name: Meowth's Pay Day
miaomiao_jubaogong.shortDescription: Meowth gains money equal to damage dealt
miaomiao_jubaogong.fullDescription:
When Meowth-line Pokémon
deal damage with attacks,
gain money equal to 100%
of the damage dealt.
Requires 3 Money tag
talents.

jinqian_gongshi.name: Money Offensive
jinqian_gongshi.shortDescription: Every 10k money grants Meowth-line +1% all stats
jinqian_gongshi.fullDescription:
Every 10,000 money grants Meowth-line Pokémon +1% to all stats.
Bonus is recalculated in real-time whenever money changes.

jiujiqian.name: Emergency Funds
jiujiqian.fullDescription:
Immediately gain 24% of current money.
This talent can be obtained unlimited times.

qian_yue_duo_qian_yue_shao.name: More Money, Less Money
qian_yue_duo_qian_yue_shao.shortDescription: Every 10 waves, spend 50% money for permanent stats
qian_yue_duo_qian_yue_shao.fullDescription:
Every 10 waves, consume
50% of current money.
For every 20,000 consumed,
permanently increase all
Pokémon stats by 1%.
Bonus is rounded
(10,100 grants +1%,
9,900 grants +0%).
Requires 8 Money tag
talents.

sanbaogong.name: Scatter Coins
sanbaogong.shortDescription: Pay Day spends money to boost damage
sanbaogong.fullDescription:
When Meowth-line uses
Pay Day or G-Max Gold Rush,
consume 10% of current
money. For every 1,000
consumed, increase that
attack's final damage by 1%,
up to 500% max.
Requires 8 Money tag
talents.

xieniu.name: Blood Bull
xieniu.fullDescription:
All your Pokémon's Max HP
increases by 50%.
Stackable, +50% per stack,
max 8 stacks.

beishuiyizhan.name: Last Stand
beishuiyizhan.fullDescription:
When HP is below 50%,
Attack and Sp. Atk
increase by 15%.
Stackable, +15% per stack,
max 3 stacks.

jingjizhjia.name: Thorns Armor
jingjizhjia.fullDescription:
When taking damage,
reflect 20% damage back
to the attacker.
Stackable, +20% per stack,
max 3 stacks.

shixuekuangbao.name: Bloodlust
shixuekuangbao.fullDescription:
When defeating an enemy
Pokémon, restore 15%
of Max HP.

shengmingjiqu.name: Life Drain
shengmingjiqu.fullDescription:
When dealing damage,
restore HP equal to 10%
of damage dealt.
Stackable, +10% per stack,
max 5 stacks.

binsifanji.name: Death's Door
binsifanji.fullDescription:
When HP is below 25%,
counter damage is doubled
and attacks always crit.
Requires 2 HP tag talents.

tongguiyujin.name: Mutual Destruction
tongguiyujin.shortDescription: Deal 50% Max HP true damage on death
tongguiyujin.fullDescription:
When a Pokémon faints,
deal true damage equal to
50% of its Max HP
to the last attacker.
Requires 2 Counter tag
talents.

xuezqiyue.name: Blood Pact
xuezqiyue.fullDescription:
All Pokémon's Max HP
reduced by 30%,
Attack and Sp. Atk
increased by 50%.
Requires 5 HP tag talents.

jingjilngyu.name: Thorn Field
jingjilngyu.shortDescription: Deal 10% of lost HP as damage at turn start
jingjilngyu.fullDescription:
At the start of each turn,
deal damage to all enemy
Pokémon equal to 10%
of your team's total
lost HP.
Requires 5 Counter tag
talents.

busizishen.name: Undying Body
busizishen.shortDescription: First fatal hit: survive at 1HP & heal 50%
busizishen.fullDescription:
Once per battle per
Pokémon, when receiving
fatal damage, survive at
1HP and restore 50%
Max HP.
Requires 5 HP tag talents.
